alt: 街坊每天都會經過噴水池，大家早已習慣，照常散步看書；第一次來的遊客卻看得很驚喜。
scene_prompt: 司空見慣 means something seen often has become ordinary and unsurprising. A modern neighborhood square with a familiar gently dancing fountain. Local residents routinely pass by without surprise: an adult calmly reads on a bench, another walks a dog, a shopkeeper sweeps nearby. In contrast one clearly visiting family with a simple travel map and camera admires the fountain with fresh wide-eyed excitement. The same harmless sight is novel to visitors but completely routine to locals. Warm everyday community, no cultural stereotypes, no famous landmarks, no logos, no readable map or camera text. Fountain is modest ordinary public fountain, not a spectacular miracle.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Scene:
